title: Grade 4 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #19

pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the lesson of Bharat refusing the throne? (1 mark)
   A. Grab wealth
   B. Be humble and do not be greedy for power
   C. Take what you like
   D. Never obey

2. What are bhajans? (1 mark)
   A. Sports
   B. Devotional songs
   C. Maps
   D. Exams

3. Which day is linked with Saturn? (1 mark)
   A. Saturday
   B. Monday
   C. Thursday
   D. Sunday

4. On which festival do many students pray to Saraswati? (1 mark)
   A. Vasant Panchami
   B. Madaraka Day
   C. Maha Shivratri
   D. Paryushan

5. Which quality of Ram is taught in the Bal Kaand? (1 mark)
   A. Cruelty
   B. Pride
   C. Respect for parents and teachers
   D. Laziness

6. Who wrote the Ramayan in Sanskrit? (1 mark)
   A. Sigala
   B. Guru Nanak
   C. Sage Valmiki
   D. Guru Arjan Dev

7. What does the word yoga mean? (1 mark)
   A. To join or unite
   B. To sleep
   C. To run
   D. To eat

8. Which teaching is linked with Guru Ram Das Ji? (1 mark)
   A. Wealth only
   B. Equality and serving others
   C. Pride
   D. War

9. Who was Devadatta in the story? (1 mark)
   A. A Sikh Guru
   B. Siddhartha's father
   C. A Jain monk
   D. Siddhartha's cousin

10. Which is the largest planet in the solar system? (1 mark)
   A. Jupiter
   B. Mercury
   C. Mars
   D. Venus

11. Which organisation set International Yoga Day? (1 mark)
   A. A school
   B. A bank
   C. A local school
   D. The United Nations

12. What is done to the Shiva Linga on Maha Shivratri? (1 mark)
   A. It is bathed with water and milk
   B. It is covered
   C. It is painted red
   D. It is thrown in a river

13. What does Utsav mean? (1 mark)
   A. Festival
   B. Yoga
   C. Prayer
   D. River

14. What does the langar teach? (1 mark)
   A. Pride
   B. Equality
   C. Fear
   D. Greed

15. What does Prani mean? (1 mark)
   A. A plant only
   B. A river
   C. A stone
   D. A living being

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Which day is Shanivaar and which planet is it linked with? (2 marks)

17. Explain what we learn from the lives of any two Enlightened Beings. (4 marks)

18. State four ways of caring for plants and water. (4 marks)

19. Give three safety measures to observe during festivals. (3 marks)

20. What is a Tirthankar? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Be humble and do not be greedy for power
   He knew the throne belonged to Ram.

2. B — Devotional songs
   Bhajans are songs of prayer.

3. A — Saturday
   Shanivaar.

4. A — Vasant Panchami
   Vasant Panchami honours Saraswati.

5. C — Respect for parents and teachers
   Ram was truthful, polite and brave.

6. C — Sage Valmiki
   Valmiki is honoured as its author.

7. A — To join or unite
   Yoga joins body, breath and mind.

8. B — Equality and serving others
   He taught that all people are equal and service is important.

9. D — Siddhartha's cousin
   Devadatta was a cousin.

10. A — Jupiter
   Jupiter is the biggest.

11. D — The United Nations
   The UN chose the day in 2014.

12. A — It is bathed with water and milk
   This is called abhishek.

13. A — Festival
   Utsav means festival.

14. B — Equality
   Everyone sits side by side to eat.

15. D — A living being
   Prani is a living creature.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: Saturday, linked with Saturn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: Any two, for example: from Prahlad's story that faith and honesty can defeat pride, and from Siddhartha that we must be kind to hurt animals.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each being with a correct lesson.

18. (4 marks)
   Answer: Plant a tree or Tulsi, water plants early or late in the day, collect rainwater, close taps and mend leaks, and never throw plastic into rivers (any four).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct way.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Adults light lamps, stay with adults in crowds, wash hands before eating, use bins, walk and do not run (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: A Jain teacher who shows people the path to freedom, like a guide across a river.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for teacher, 1 mark for showing the path.
